_: Known waits for test/regress.mjs: where a golden bot may stand still on purpose (cell within r, up to max seconds), and each level's death budget. Anything else that stands 10 s or more fails the push.

waits.why: on the heap after the last wave: the kings ride in, Tsotha's offer
the conclave: hearing out the kings and the wizard, answering them
the Vault: chained, lie still while Satha passes, then the keys
Satha returns: in the alcove, the torch shaken out, keeping still while she passes
the choke: back to the fallen stones, waiting for the weeping thing to come at you
the cage: the vine cut, Pelias gets to his feet and speaks
the gold-domed chamber: Pelias and the wine, the crystal
the tallest tower: Pelias calls the beast, and his promise
Tsotha fallen: the ending plays out
